A set of tactile, drop-in installations built for parties and events-turning a room of strangers into teams. Hands-on puzzles feed a live leaderboard and a collective finale. Rated 9.23/10 by 116 guests at Google DeepMind's holiday party. Step into the roaring twenties and solve a daring jazz club robbery - laser-cut game boards, interactive oil paintings, and an 8-foot London-style phone booth, installed right in your office.
